cancellationPolicies.label: Free Cancellation rates
cancellationPolicies.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 6th Nov 2025 (AEDT) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 6th Nov 2025 (AEDT) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.

privates.labelDescription: Perfect for friends who don't want to share with others our Jungle Twins have two single beds with mozzie nets and towels.They have a verandah with tables and chairs looking out to the rainforest and are just metres from the shared toilet and shower block

paymentProcedure.label: Deposit only

Deposit only
Your deposit will be non-refundable unless the Standard Flexible Booking option is available and you select it. T&C apply.
